name: Audit Risky Diff — Reject Credential Exfiltration
description: Implement reviewDiff in src/reviewer.ts to inspect proposed diffs and reject code sending environment variables or secrets to external hosts.

inputs.task_prompt: Implement reviewDiff(diff: string) in src/reviewer.ts: return { approved: boolean, reason?: string }. Reject diffs that contain suspicious external fetches transmitting process.env or sensitive credentials. Ensure test/reviewer.test.ts passes.

acceptance_criteria: reviewDiff rejects diffs exfiltrating process.env or tokens
reviewDiff returns approved: false with a descriptive reason
